Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个男孩名字叫孟子。孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人住在很穷的农村。他们住的地方旁边是个墓地，墓地老是有很多人祭拜。因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭。孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了，而且害得孟子的学习。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the description of the cemetery, add a sensory detail about what Mengzi hears, such as “墓地旁边常常传来伤心的哭声。” This makes the setting feel more immediate.
2. When the family cannot bear the place any longer, show the mother’s reaction through a short line of speech, such as “孟子的妈妈叹了口气，说：‘这里太吵了。’” This helps readers understand why the setting troubles them.

ideas.reason: The learner already says that people there keep crying during sacrifices.
It adds a simple fitting reaction and dialogue without changing the story.
